1. Acceptance of Terms
 By creating an account on Comrades, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

 2. Privacy and Data Security
 We respect your privacy. Your personal phone number is collected solely for the purpose of processing M-Pesa transactions (deposits and withdrawals). Personal phone numbers are strictly confidential and will never be shared with other users or members of any group.

 3. User Responsibility
 You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials. Any activity under your account is your responsibility.

 4. Financial Transactions
 All deposits, withdrawals, and loan applications are final once processed. Group contributions are managed by the group admin according to group rules.

 5. Prohibited Conduct
 Users are prohibited from attempting to defraud the system, other users, or groups. Sharing personal contact information in public group spaces is discouraged to maintain privacy.

 6. Limitation of Liability
 Comrades is provided "as is" without any warranties. We are not liable for any financial losses incurred due to user error or market conditions.

 7. Termination
 We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in suspicious activity.
